title: Home Depot Bulk Inventory by ZIP
description: Enter Home Depot Internet IDs, product URLs, or Store SKUs and US ZIP codes. The Actor returns a complete product × nearby-store inventory matrix.

products.title: Internet IDs, Store SKUs, or URLs
products.description: Use Home Depot Internet IDs, product URLs, or Store SKUs. Prefix a Store SKU with sku: to make its type explicit. Consult the live Actor pricing page for current event prices.

zipCodes.title: US ZIP codes
zipCodes.description: Five-digit US ZIP codes to resolve to nearby Home Depot stores. Cost scales with the matrix: products times ZIPs times storesPerZip. Malformed ZIPs are rejected by input validation before anything runs or bills.

storesPerZip.title: Nearby stores per ZIP
storesPerZip.description: Number of nearby Home Depot stores checked for each ZIP.

maxMatrixRows.title: Maximum product × store rows
maxMatrixRows.description: Maximum product by ZIP by store matrix size. Successful rows may be billed; consult the live Actor pricing page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: US residential proxy is the default and the validated route. If you pass a custom configuration, keep RESIDENTIAL groups with US country: a plain datacenter override gets blocked by Home Depot and produces only free BLOCKED rows.
